name: com.grbhxr.lensing
description: Physics-auditable Kerr lensing for PCVR. Two runtime paths: real-time lookup of offline-traced transfer maps (baked), and live Cartesian Kerr-Schild geodesic integration in a compute shader, amortized over several display frames and hard-swapped only when a pass completes. Not a static texture bridge, and not a full-resolution per-eye per-frame solve. Meta MRUK passthrough is late-bound and unaccepted: no calibrated camera-frame delivery has been demonstrated on device.
